name: tooling-ungrouped-sweep
brief: Close the remaining Tooling and Ungrouped backlog items except the live-claude hand-run harness. Add a project frontend discipline fragment requiring a named-error guard under noUncheckedIndexedAccess and register it in .sir/config.json; give the renderer stub's three non-projects Beachcomber rows pathSource 'absolute-path'; give PodsChrome's tabIndex=-1 focus-fallback container an inset focus-visible ring using the existing focus-ring tokens; make closePod skip the sweep, updatePod and podStatus push for an already-closed Pod and update the whole-record test count; make DeletePodDialog re-focus when podId changes A to B while open. The commit-msg hook item closes as declined. The Prettier item's premise was found false at spec time (the repo has no formatter config, so every tracked TS file fails a default check) and is decided at Gate 2. Gate 3 removes the closed items from .sir/backlog.md.
